pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, predominantly polygonal dark regions on the upper flank and mid-neck. Edges exhibit high-contrast pixel gradients with sharp angular transitions. Patch area decreases significantly and morphology becomes more irregular and rounded toward the lower flank and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of high-luminance light pelage. Corridors are thickest along the dorsal ridge and mid-flank, narrowing to thin filaments on the lower limbs and ventral area. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections forming a non-uniform lattice.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency fringe visible along the neck line. The silhouette is composed of fine vertical pixel clusters against the background, though partially occluded by foreground vegetation in the upper-right quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in pattern density is visible where the large-scale dorsal polygons break into significantly smaller, more dispersed fragments on the lower limb and belly region.
